assets.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram. Asset type: 16:9 Chinese technical blog cover.
Create a refined, editorial illustration for a blog about AUUC, uplift model evaluation. Wide 16:9 composition, light ivory white background, restrained blue, sage and warm orange palette, crisp attractive graphic design. Three meaningful visual elements only: a small cluster of user cards, a single red coupon suggesting an intervention, and a clean uplift gain curve on the right with pale blue area beneath it and a lower orange dashed random baseline. The model curve rises quickly, plateaus, then gently dips to join the random baseline at the right endpoint. The plot is conceptual: no numbered axes, no fabricated measured results. Clear confident typography, large readable title "AUUC" and short Chinese subtitle "用增益曲线评估排序". Beautiful balanced negative space, subtle depth on cards, excellent small-thumbnail legibility. No computers, desks, robots, neon circuits, dense formulas, watermarks or decorative technical labels. All text must match the two specified strings exactly.

Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: Chinese technical flowchart design reference, wide 16:9.
Create a polished, precise AUUC evaluation process diagram, flat vector-like aesthetic on pure white, low-saturation blue, sage and lavender, dark slate text. Design intended to be faithfully rebuilt with editable PowerPoint shapes and text. Very clear left-to-right reading order, four equal stage modules, slim arrows with modest arrowheads between them. Top title "AUUC 的计算流程".
Stage 1 title "独立测试集"; body three short lines "实际分组 W", "购买结果 Y", "预测分数".
Stage 2 title "按分数排序"; body "分数从高到低", "相同分数一起取点".
Stage 3 title "累计增益"; body "选取前 k 人", "两组购买率差 × k".
Stage 4 title "曲线积分"; body "补上原点", "梯形法计算面积".
Below stages use one simple large shared band titled "每个点都统计累计前缀". Three equally spaced examples in this band:
"前 100 人" / "(20/50 − 5/50) × 100" / "增益 30 人";
"前 200 人" / "(30/100 − 10/100) × 200" / "增益 40 人";
"前 500 人" / "(50/250 − 25/250) × 500" / "增益 50 人".
Keep exact arithmetic and Chinese text. Large readable labels, generous spacing, clean geometric boundaries and visible connectors. No ornament, no photos, no pseudo scientific decoration. This is an explanatory flowchart, not an application UI.
